title: Duckling dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- duckling dancing: body yellow, head yellow, beak orange, feet orange, wing lighter yellow, musical notes cyan -->
  <!-- musical notes -->
  <ellipse cx='16' cy='24' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#57e0ff'/>
  <rect x='19' y='12' width='2.5' height='13' fill='#57e0ff'/>
  <ellipse cx='84' cy='18' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#57e0ff'/>
  <rect x='87' y='6' width='2.5' height='13' fill='#57e0ff'/>
  <ellipse cx='88' cy='38' rx='3.2' ry='2.4' fill='#8ef0ff'/>
  <rect x='90' y='28' width='2' height='11' fill='#8ef0ff'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='40' y='70' width='5' height='14' rx='2.5' fill='#ff9a2e'/>
  <rect x='58' y='70' width='5' height='14' rx='2.5' fill='#ff9a2e'/>
  <!-- webbed feet, kicked out in dance -->
  <path d='M34 88 L42 82 L48 88 L42 86 Z' fill='#ffb84d'/>
  <path d='M56 86 L62 80 L56 88 Z' fill='#ffb84d' transform='translate(6,2) scale(-1,1) translate(-112,0)'/>
  <path d='M53 88 L60 82 L67 86 L61 85 Z' fill='#ffb84d'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='60' rx='24' ry='20' fill='#ffd93d'/>
  <!-- wing raised for dancing -->
  <path d='M30 54 Q18 44 24 36 Q32 40 34 50 Z' fill='#ffe98a'/>
  <path d='M70 54 Q82 42 76 34 Q68 40 66 50 Z' fill='#ffe98a'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='32' r='16' fill='#ffd93d'/>
  <!-- little tuft -->
  <path d='M46 17 Q48 10 52 16 Q54 11 56 18' stroke='#ffb84d' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- beak -->
  <path d='M64 32 Q76 29 74 36 Q68 39 64 36 Z' fill='#ff8c1a'/>
  <line x1='65' y1='35' x2='73' y2='34' stroke='#e07000' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='29' r='2.6' fill='#2b1a4d'/>
  <circle cx='54' cy='29' r='2.6' fill='#2b1a4d'/>
  <circle cx='44.8' cy='28.2' r='0.9' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='54.8' cy='28.2' r='0.9' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- blush -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='36' rx='3.5' ry='2' fill='#ffab9e'/>
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='37' rx='3.5' ry='2' fill='#ffab9e'/>
</svg>
